diagnostics.impact: Reduces specific metrics and diagnostic collectors. Does not block all telemetry.

promotions.impact: Removes shopping, promotional, tutorial and release-note components; corresponding features may stop working.

recognition.impact: Disables identified content-recognition and advertising-ID components. Some personalization may stop working.

alexa.impact: Disables Alexa, voice-assistant features, Alexa alerts and notifications. Keep this group off if you use Alexa.
